verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments layer for AI agents. A platform like this could plausibly offer scheduled or background automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no product-run automation, scheduler, trigger or recurring job: only API keys, token creation and charging, and an MCP server that lets the user's own agent create tokens and 'orchestrate agent commerce workflows'. Those are building blocks an external agent uses, not autonomous background automations that Skyfire runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
